findings.issue: esc70 hand-built runs give repeats None in _answered, the shape of the node child. The python child always sends a list (diag_windows_2025.txt: repeats [2134, 2]), so the growth fault the real python pass produces carries the suffix ", over [..] searches a length" (timing_faults 1957-1960). esc70 builds its owed text without that suffix, so deleting the suffix, or breaking its formatting, leaves every case green: a branch of the growth fault the real pass uses is held by no case.
findings.resolution: Let _answered take a repeats argument and give the cost at the 1.75 power a list as the python child sends it (for example [3, 2]); build the owed text with the suffix ", over [3, 2] searches a length", so the whole growth fault the real python pass emits is compared.
